description: Eni agreed in 1999 to contribute US$760,000 through WHO/Europe to a three-year malaria-control plan developed by the Ministry of Health. This supported a broad package including diagnosis/treatment, vector control, surveillance, research capacity and community engagement.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Period begins before study window; amount is a reported contribution, not verified annual spend or total national expenditure.

description: Large-scale IRS campaigns were introduced around 1999–2000; the article describes spraying twice annually.
evidence_status: documented programme history; annual coverage not quantified in this row
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Do not infer household coverage or exact annual spray counts beyond the reported twice-yearly schedule.

description: Seasonal chloroquine chemoprophylaxis was discontinued after 2000.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: This does not mean treatment for confirmed malaria was discontinued.

description: Government endorsed the Tashkent Regional Declaration, “The Move from Malaria Control to Elimination,” in 2005.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Policy milestone, not a measured intervention coverage variable.

description: National strategy aimed to interrupt local transmission by 2013 and maintain malaria-free status in areas where transmission had been eliminated.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan

description: About 50,000 long-lasting insecticidal nets were distributed during 2009–2012, primarily targeting pregnant women and children under five in refugee camps.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Number distributed is an output, not coverage percentage or evidence of use.

description: The article reports that Global Fund support for malaria control began in 2009.
evidence_status: support documented; amount not established by this source
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: No grant amount or annual disbursement is entered because this source does not establish it. Obtain grant-level data separately.

description: An electronic integrated disease surveillance system was introduced for malaria reporting in 2009.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: No annual completeness or timeliness measure encoded.

event_or_intervention: Microscopy-based diagnosis and public-sector treatment access
description: Diagnosis was based on microscopy and free of charge in the public sector; the article reports 233 laboratories capable of malaria diagnosis and external quality assurance.
quantity_unit: laboratories capable of diagnosis (reported in article)
evidence_status: documented programme capacity; year-specific count not asserted
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Article reports network capacity and QA; do not interpret as insurance coverage. This row records the described system, not a verified annual count for every year.

event_or_intervention: Mass primaquine treatment in selected districts
description: Mass primaquine treatment was conducted in selected districts; the article reports more than 10,000 people reached across seven districts in 2011.
evidence_status: reported minimum/approximate threshold; not exact count
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Use quantity as >10,000 in interpretation; numeric field stores 10000 as a lower-bound value.

event_or_intervention: Active case detection and blood examination
description: The programme used active detection in high-risk areas; approximately 30–40% of malaria blood samples were collected through active detection. Annual blood examination coverage remained above 4% in 2013 and 2014.
evidence_status: documented; period-specific coverage figures are only stated for 2013–2014
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Do not apply the 30–40% sample share or >4% blood examination coverage to every year in the period.

description: Joint coordination meeting in 2009; joint malaria-elimination activities launched in 2010.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: For a country polygon map, this is a bilateral event; do not assign it only to Azerbaijan without indicating the cross-border scope.

description: Published account identifies 2012 as the year of the last indigenous case.
evidence_status: documented milestone; exact annual count discrepancy should be checked against selected WHO data vintage
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Supplied country-year file lists 3 indigenous cases in 2012; the article text describes 2 indigenous cases among 3 total cases. Preserve and resolve this discrepancy explicitly.

event_or_intervention: No indigenous cases in post-transmission period
description: The elimination article reports no indigenous cases after the last local case; the WHO European Region reached zero indigenous cases overall in 2015.
evidence_status: documented regional milestone; national zero values retained from supplied case series pending vintage validation
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Country-level zero and region-wide zero are distinct claims. Region-wide milestone is 2015.

event_or_intervention: Continued blood examination after zero indigenous cases
description: Annual blood examination coverage remained above 4% in 2013 and 2014 despite no indigenous case being detected.
source_citation: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
interpretation_limit: Useful evidence that surveillance continued after local transmission ceased.
